---
name: Bug report
about: Something does not behave as documented
labels: bug
---

**What happened**

**Command or API call** (e.g. `npcc c in.bin out.npcc`, `python3 -m npcc c`, `POST /api/compress`, or the Python `compress()` call)

**Input** (smallest reproducer, or describe the data class — never attach private data)

**Expected vs actual output**

**Version** (`npcc --version`) and platform (`uname -a`, `gcc --version`)

**Claim / verification issue?** If you are disputing a benchmark figure, see the
Claim lock section of the README and include the exact command, corpus, and
dates so the figure can be re-verified.

Security problems: please follow SECURITY.md instead of opening an issue.
